output.title: Output
output.webOptimizedHelp: Puts the index at the start of the MP4 file (faststart), so that playback over a network can start before the whole file has loaded.
output.alignAvStartHelp: Makes audio and video start at the same time, for players that do not handle an offset between them.
output.passthruMetadataHelp: Copies the source's title, dates and other common tags first; the Tags tab can change each of them.

jobType.title: Job type
jobType.failed: The job type cannot be found: {reason}
jobType.editInPlaceHelp: Reframe writes the new track languages, names and flags, and the title, into the MKV source itself, in seconds, and no new file is written. This works only when nothing but metadata changes.
jobType.inPlace: The source file itself is changed: {path}. No new file is written, so the output name and folder are not used.
jobType.canEditInPlace: Only metadata changes: with Edit in place, {name} itself is changed in seconds instead of a new file being written.
jobType.blocked: Edit in place is not possible because:
jobType.remuxOnlyHelp: Drafts the job again so that the video and every audio and subtitle track are copied as they are into a new file: only languages, names and flags change.
jobType.remuxOnlyInPlaceHelp: Drafts the job again so that the video and every audio and subtitle track are copied as they are. Edit in place is on: the source file itself is edited, and no new file is written.
